pm.question: Counter-Strike: Aurora Gaming vs 9z (BO3) - Thunderpick World Championship Group A

factors.summary: Summer rebuild: Jimpphat joined from MOUZ on 3 Jul 2026 and kyxsan joined from Falcons on 8 Jul 2026 as in-game leader; coach ash. HLTV lists 62 maps for the new five (Jimpphat 104 days, kyxsan 99 days on the team when read). Valve's standings show 17 rated matches for this exact five since 22 Jul 2026. Not a days-old change, but still an evolving system per coach ash (HLTV interview, Aug 2026).

Before TWC, 9z had group-stage exits at four straight events (EWC, BLAST Porto, FPG 3, EPL 24) per HLTV, then beat Aurora 2-0 (Inferno 13-11, Nuke 13-1; luchov 1.61 rating). HLTV's match list confirms 9z vs Falcons at 11:00 UTC on 15 Oct (Pinnacle lists 11:30).

strategy.reason: Real upset chance, heavily faded by the crowd, plus a verified factor (roster change, stand-in or late replacement) against the favourite.

info.about: Thunderpick World Championship 2026 (Malta, HLTV event 8932) day 1 = 14 Oct 2026. Results, maps and ratings from HLTV; pre-match prices from the Pinnacle guest API reads archived in this repository (session 8944bb84, read 2026-10-14 01:48 UTC); Hotspawn crowd pick shares from the pre-lock board capture (session 8e782f95, board/data/analysis.csv). Derived numbers (de-vig, own line, strategy class) are recomputed by hotspawn/model.py with today's rule so the review shows what the rule would have said. Compiled by arena/22be6967 on 2026-10-15 10:10-10:30 UTC.

event.name: Thunderpick World Championship 2026
event.format: Two BO3 GSL groups of four; top two per group to single-elimination BO3 playoffs; BO5 grand final after a third-place decider.

price_source.label: Pinnacle guest API (direct event reads), archived in data/8944bb84/external_lines.csv

crowd_source.label: Hotspawn crowd pick share captured before lock (board/data/analysis.csv, columns crowd_pct_*_audit_only)
crowd_source.note: Captured hours before lock on 2026-10-13/14, not at lock; final shares may differ.

lessons: The only upset (9z over Aurora) came from the side with the largest gap between our own line and the crowd: the official-points line gave 9z about 39% while the market said 27% and only 5% of Hotspawn players picked 9z. A correct pick there gained 7 points on 95% of the field.

The three favourites the crowd agreed with all won 2-0, so 'chalk' cost nothing on day 1; contrarian picks pay off only when the underdog's real chance is large, which is why the rule requires a minimum probability before fading the crowd.

Roster churn is a usable signal but not proof: Aurora's July rebuild did not stop a 3rd place at EPL S24, yet the team still lost 0-2 here. Treat onboarding as a tiebreaker on close matches, not as a reason to back long shots.

matches.context: Aurora (#5 VRS per HLTV) rebuilt in July (kyxsan IGL, Jimpphat); they had beaten 9z 2-0 at EPL S24 on 3 Oct. 9z arrived after four straight group-stage exits.

strategy.reason: Real upset chance, heavily faded by the crowd, plus a verified factor (roster change, stand-in or late replacement) against the favourite.

flag_text.KICKOFF_GAP: Outside source lists a different kickoff than Hotspawn (joined because both teams match and the gap is within 6 h).
flag_text.ALIAS: A team name was joined through a verified alias (see research/aliases.json for the evidence).
flag_text.NO_MARKET: No outside price found; the probability is our own line from official Valve points.
flag_text.MODEL_MARKET_SPLIT: Our own line and the market disagree on the favourite or by 10+ points.
flag_text.BOOK_PM_SPLIT: Pinnacle and Polymarket differ by 8+ points.
flag_text.VRS_ROSTER_OUTDATED: A verified roster change happened after Valve's latest standings, so Valve points describe a different five.
flag_text.FORMAT_UNKNOWN: No source stated the series length; nothing was assumed.
flag_text.UNRESOLVED: No outside price and at least one team is missing from Valve's standings; pick left blank.
flag_text.STALE_LISTING: Hotspawn still lists this fixture although its lock time passed more than 36 h ago (not pickable).
flag_text.LOCKED: Lock time has passed; kept for the record and for grading.
flag_text.CROWD_MISSING: Hotspawn did not publish a crowd share; no leaderboard play computed.
flag_text.HOTSPAWN_PARTIAL: Not every Hotspawn page was read successfully in this capture.
flag_text.COIN_FLIP: Probabilities within one point of 50%; pick follows our own line.
flag_text.STALE_PRICE: The outside price was read more than 8 h before this build.
